title: Clearer Arabic typography and home labels
summary: Use bundled Noto Sans Arabic, readable navigation and button sizes, and more natural Arabic home-card wording.

changes.detail: Replace the Arabic UI font that rendered poorly at small sizes with bundled Noto Sans Arabic Regular and SemiBold, with web sans-serif fallbacks.
Increase Arabic button labels to 15px and bottom tabs to 12px; clarify daily challenge, journey and tutor wording.
Include font license and provenance documentation. Existing font assets and history remain preserved.

validation.name: Baseline browser reproduction
validation.detail: Reproduced the screenshot at 390px in Edge; CDP confirmed IBM Plex custom fonts were loaded. This was poor small-size rendering, not missing font requests.

validation.name: Post-change checks
validation.detail: Typecheck, focused lint, change history checks and responsive visual validation pending. Native devices and production deployment not tested.
